Dominique Wilkins

Pronunciation: \dom-in-EEK\

Jacques Dominique Wilkins

(Nique, The Human Highlight Film, Nique-a-Zoid, Zoid)

Position: Small Forward ▪ Shoots: Right

6-8, 215lb (203cm, 97kg)

Born: January 12, 1960 in Paris, France fr

Relatives: Brother Gerald Wilkins; Nephew Damien Wilkins; Stepson Isaiah Wilkins

College: Georgia

High School: Washington in Washington, North Carolina

Draft: Utah Jazz, 1st round (3rd pick, 3rd overall), 1982 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: October 29, 1982

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2006 (Full List)

Career Length: 15 years

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Dominique Wilkins?

Dominique Wilkins is 66 years old.

Where was Dominique Wilkins born?

Dominique Wilkins was born in Paris, France.

When was Dominique Wilkins born?

Dominique Wilkins was born on January 12, 1960.

How tall is Dominique Wilkins?

Dominique Wilkins is 6-8 (203 cm) tall.

How much did Dominique Wilkins weigh when playing?

Dominique Wilkins weighed 215 lbs (97 kg) when playing.

Is Dominique Wilkins in the Hall of Fame?

Dominique Wilkins was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2006 (Full List) .

When was Dominique Wilkins drafted?

Dominique Wilkins was drafted by Utah Jazz, 1st round (3rd pick, 3rd overall), 1982 NBA Draft.

What position did Dominique Wilkins play?

Small Forward.

When did Dominique Wilkins retire?

Dominique Wilkins last played in 1999.

What is Dominique Wilkins' net worth?

Dominique Wilkins made at least $23,687,500 playing professional basketball.

How much did Dominique Wilkins make?

Dominique Wilkins made $3,500,000 in 1993.

What did Dominique Wilkins average?

Dominique Wilkins averaged 24.8 points, 6.7 rebounds, and 2.5 assists per game.

How many rings does Dominique Wilkins have?

Dominique Wilkins won 0 championships.

What schools did Dominique Wilkins attend?

Dominique Wilkins attended Washington in Washington, North Carolina and Georgia.

What are Dominique Wilkins' nicknames?

Nique, The Human Highlight Film, Nique-a-Zoid, Zoid are nicknames for Dominique Wilkins.
